segments.sn45.78-82:1.1: 78-82. “Nāhaṃ, bhikkhave, aññaṃ ekadhammampi samanupassāmi, yena anuppanno vā ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo uppajjati, uppanno vā ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati, yathayidaṃ, bhikkhave, sīlasampadā … pe … yathayidaṃ, bhikkhave, chandasampadā … pe … yathayidaṃ, bhikkhave, attasampadā … pe … yathayidaṃ, bhikkhave, diṭṭhisampadā … pe … yathayidaṃ, bhikkhave, appamādasampadā … pe ….
